{{External|rs}}
'''Shortcuts''' can be found all around [[Gielinor]]. By climbing cliff sides, crossing rivers and squeezing through crevices, it is possible to reach a destination more directly than by the alternative route. Nearly all shortcuts require the proper [[Agility]] level. There are no guaranteed rewards for using shortcuts, except that they will save you time, but they will sometimes give small amounts of Agility experience. All shortcuts, Asgarnian Ice Dungeon [[Tunnel (Asgarnian Ice Dungeon, level 60)|tunnel]], and crandor south [[Rocks (Crandor)|rocks]], are [[P2P]], and some require [[Ranged]] and [[Strength]] levels. Two-way shortcuts are identified with a twisting green arrow icon ([[File:Agility shortcut icon.png]]) on the [[minimap]], with one-way shortcuts using an inverted arrow icon ([[File:Agility shortcut (One way) icon.png]]).

Agility '''Areas''' are locations that are locked behind an obstacle with an Agility requirement. There is no standard way to access these locations, although some such as the [[God Wars Dungeon]] have an alternative entrance using a different skill.

}}

|change = The following have been added to the game:<br/>

*A shortcut between the entrance and the [[Fire giants]] that you can use at level 46 [[agility]] if you have completed the [[Wilderness Medium Diary]].
*A shortcut in the [[Motherlode Mine]] that you can use at level 54 [[agility]] if you have completed the [[Falador Medium Diary]].
*A shortcut between the [[Miscellania]] docks and [[Etceteria]] that you can use at level 55 [[agility]] if you have completed the [[Fremennik Medium Diary]].
*A shortcut across the estuary on [[Mos Le'Harmless]] that you can use at level 60 [[agility]] if you have completed the [[Morytania Hard Diary]].
*A shortcut between [[Lumbridge Swamp]] and the [[Kharidian Desert]] that you can use at level 66 [[agility]] if you have completed the [[Hard Lumbridge|Hard Lumbridge & Draynor Diary]].
*A shortcut in the basement of the [[Heroes' Guild]] to the [[Fountain of Heroes]] that you can use at level 67 [[agility]] if you have completed the [[Falador Hard Diary]].
*A shortcut from the entrance to the roof of the [[Troll Stronghold (location)|Troll Stronghold]] that you can use at level 73 [[agility]] if you have completed the [[Fremennik Hard Diary]].
*A shortcut on the south side to [[Lava Dragon Isle]] that you can use at level 74 [[agility]] if you have completed the [[Wilderness Hard Diary]].
*A shortcut across the [[Shilo Village (location)|Shilo Village]] river that you can use at level 77 [[agility]] if you have completed the [[Karamja Elite Diary]].
*A shortcut in the [[Brimhaven Dungeon]] leading to the [[red dragon]]s that you can use at level 83 [[agility]] if you have completed the [[Karamja Elite Diary]].
*A shortcut in the [[Kalphite Lair]] that you can use at level 86 [[agility]] if you have completed the [[Desert Elite Diary]].
}}
